entry.title: Choosing which "list of…" gets printed
entry.summary: One option turns off the List of Tables, Listings or Algorithms — without editing the configuration file that registers them.

entry.title: novathesis 8.3.0 — Stork: Flying International
entry.summary: The template leaves Portugal for the first time, with Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin, plus appendix labels, a way to skip individual lists, and a chapter-styles showcase.

entry.title: novathesis 8.2.0 — Hummingbird: Travelling Light
entry.summary: A new school — Faculdade de Farmácia da Universidade de Lisboa — a build option to cap the PDF size, and a fix for AMS symbols under pdfLaTeX.

entry.title: novathesis 8.1.0 — Peacock: New Plumage
entry.summary: The template is renamed to novathesis, gains a proper colophon page, and drops its last external dependency.

entry.title: novathesis 8.0.0 — Swallow: Migration Season
entry.summary: Glossaries move to bib2gls — a migration every existing document needs — and pdfLaTeX builds get about three times faster.

entry.title: novathesis 7.10 — Chinese abstracts, and ISEL
entry.summary: Abstracts in Simplified and Traditional Chinese, support for IPL/ISEL, and automated integrity statements for NOVA FCSH.

entry.title: novathesis 7.7 and 7.8 — Declaring AI use, and three more ULisboa schools
entry.summary: A formal AI-usage declaration for your thesis, support for FCUL, IST and ISEG, and a new spine design.

entry.title: novathesis 7.6 — Sustainable Development Goals, and seven new languages
entry.summary: SDG icons on the abstract page, seven more languages for covers and fixed strings, and the Palatino font styles.
